emergency.title: Emergency?
emergency.body: Go to the nearest emergency department or call 912. MediLink is not for emergencies.

footer.tagline: Connecting people to healthcare facilities across Rwanda.
footer.trust: Search without an account. Your location is used only for your search and never stored.
footer.label: Site links

cta.title: Need care today?
cta.body: Find an open facility near you, see how busy it is and book ahead before you leave home.

authAside.label: Why an account
authAside.title: Spend less time waiting and more time getting better.
authAside.lead: One account for you and your family, at every facility on MediLink.

book.title: Book ahead
book.body: Choose a facility, a service and a time that suits you.

queue.title: Follow your place in the queue
queue.body: Leave home when it is nearly your turn, not hours before.

records.title: Your records in one place
records.body: Prescriptions, results and documents you can share safely.

authAside.trust: Your health data is protected under Rwanda’s data protection law and is only shared when you allow it.

login.intro: Book care and skip the long wait.
login.createAccount: Create an account with this email
login.invalidCredentials: The email or password is not right. Check them and try again.

google.failed: Google sign-in didn't work. Try again.

signup.title: Create your account
signup.intro: It takes about a minute. You can add insurance and family members later.
signup.passwordHint: Use at least 8 characters. A short sentence is easy to remember and hard to guess.
signup.languageHint: We send reminders and messages in this language.
signup.consentIntro: Before we create your account, please read this:
signup.consentPoint1: Your health information is encrypted and stored in Rwanda.
signup.consentPoint2: Only the facilities that care for you can see your records.
signup.consentPoint3: You can download your data or delete your account at any time.
signup.terms: I accept the terms of use
signup.privacy: I have read the privacy notice and agree to how MediLink uses my information
signup.research: I agree that my anonymised data may be used for health research
signup.researchHint: Optional. Saying no changes nothing about your care. You can change this later.
signup.checkEmailBody: We sent a message to {{email}}. Open the link in it to finish creating your account. The link works for 3 days.
signup.checkEmailHint: No email after a few minutes? Check your spam folder, or sign up again to get a new link.
signup.readyBody: Sign in with {{email}} and your password.

verifyEmail.title: Confirm your email
verifyEmail.invalidLink: This link is incomplete. Open the link from the email again.

home.description: Find care near you in Rwanda: live waits, open now, your insurance. Join the queue or book.
home.placeholder: e.g. child has fever, dentist, pregnancy check

forFacilities.title: MediLink for health facilities
forFacilities.body: Facility registration opens in the next release. You will be able to apply online and go live after verification.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.body: The full terms of use will be published here before launch, in Kinyarwanda, English and French.

privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.body: The full privacy notice will be published here before launch, in Kinyarwanda, English and French.

help.title: Help
help.body: Guides for patients and caregivers are coming. No smartphone? Ask at reception.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: Check the address, or go back to the home page.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.intro: Enter your email. If it belongs to an account, we will send a link to set a new password.
forgot.sentBody: If an account exists for {{email}}, a reset link is on its way. The link works for 30 minutes.

reset.title: Set a new password
reset.hint: At least 8 characters. A short sentence is easy to remember and hard to guess.
reset.doneBody: Your password was changed and you were logged out everywhere. Log in with your new password.
reset.invalidLink: This link is incomplete. Open the link from the email again, or ask for a new one.

shell.offline: You're offline. You're seeing what was last saved on this phone.

support.title: Help

ticket.q: How do I follow my turn?
ticket.a: After reception checks you in, open My visits. Your ticket number, how many people are ahead and the expected wait are there. We tell you when you're next.

family.q: Can I manage my child's visits?
family.a: Yes. Add your child under Family. You can then switch to their profile from the top of the screen.

language.q: How do I change the language or make the text bigger?
language.a: Open Settings from the account menu. You can choose Kinyarwanda, English or French and a larger text size.

data.q: Who can see my health records?
data.a: Only staff at a facility where you are being cared for. Every time someone opens your record it is logged, and you can see the list under Privacy.

support.deskBody: No smartphone, or stuck? Reception staff at any MediLink facility can check you in and answer questions.
support.reportBody: Soon you can report a problem with a visit, a payment or a document here and follow what happens.

settings.title: Settings
settings.intro: These choices apply right away and are kept on this device.
settings.textSizeHint: Larger text makes every screen easier to read. Buttons grow with it.
settings.travelBody: When you have a ticket, tell us how long it takes you to reach the facility. We use it to tell you when to leave home.
settings.alertsBody: Soon you can choose how we reach you: on this phone, by SMS or by email.
